label: ACCEPT
reason: Every versioned codemod's default export goes through createTransformer, directly (v5/rename-message-to-ui-message.ts, v7/move-include-raw-chunks-to-include.ts) or via lib factories (v4/remove-openai-facade.ts). jscodeshift would run a bare transformer, and no oxlint or type rule requires the wrapper, so a new codemod that skips it is worth flagging. All five outliers are lib/ helpers or factories, including createTransformer itself, so they are legitimately different. Hesitated with WRONG mixed_group because the role includes lib/, but that is only 5 of 114 members.
